name: The Donation App
shortDescription: A UK charity donation and Gift Aid platform from Abacus Apps, covering online giving, card and e-wallet payments, bank transfers, cash records, CSV imports, GASDS and automated HMRC claims.
suitableContexts: Church charities that need Gift Aid and GASDS workflows alongside several donation channels
Churches migrating existing donation records by CSV
Churches wanting to automate or reduce manual Charity Online claim administration

pricing.summary: The Donation App advertises plans from £9 per month after a free 14-day trial, with custom pricing for more than 10,500 unique donors. It describes Bronze, Silver and Gold workflow tiers but the reviewed search material does not establish all live tier prices, payment-processing charges, VAT, contract or cancellation conditions; obtain these in writing.

tiers.label: Bronze
tiers.detail: CSV donation import and Gift Aid claims in three clicks.

tiers.label: Silver
tiers.detail: Integrated payments and described automated Gift Aid workflow.

tiers.label: Gold
tiers.detail: Supplier describes combined own-channel and platform payments, cash management, CSV import and Gift Aid or GASDS claims.

pricing.trialDetails: Supplier advertises a free 14-day Gift Aid automation trial and onboarding help for historic Gift Aid backlogs.

gdprInformation: The Donation App publishes a privacy notice with rights requests through the account or apps@abacusaps.uk. Its own feature pages describe online payments, bank transfer, cash and donor information, so a church should obtain the current controller-processor allocation, DPA, payment-provider terms, hosting location, sub-processors, retention schedule, access controls, breach process and export procedure before loading donor records.
coreFeatures: Gift Aid and GASDS claim workflows
integrations: Supplier describes integrated card, e-wallet and bank-transfer donation routes
Request current payment-provider, accounting, CRM and web integration documentation
importExport: Gift Aid-ready CSV template for donation imports
Request full donor, donation, declaration, claim, payment, audit-trail and attachment export specifications
support: Supplier offers an eight-minute demo video and an instant-demo route
Supplier describes a dedicated onboarding team during the trial
Request support hours, response commitments and migration scope

uk-operator.value: Companies House records ABACUS APPS LIMITED (11757195) as an active English private limited company. The product site and current HMRC supplier list name Abacus Apps Limited as the supplier.

hmrc-recognition.value: HMRC's current commercial Charities Online supplier list names Abacus Apps Limited and The Donation App, identifying suppliers that have provided evidence of software able to interact with Charities Online.

pricing.value: Supplier advertises Gift Aid automation from £9 per month after a 14-day trial and says custom pricing applies above 10,500 unique donors.

giving-and-claim-workflows.value: Supplier documents card, e-wallet, bank-transfer, contactless, cash and CSV donation workflows, alongside Gift Aid and GASDS claims.

editorial.assessment: The Donation App is a UK charity-giving and Gift Aid specialist rather than a full church-management platform. Its breadth across bank transfer, cash, online and contactless donations is potentially useful for churches with fragmented giving records, while its HMRC supplier listing is useful external evidence for the claim connection. The published site makes ambitious automation claims; a church should prove its exact declaration, reconciliation, payment and access-control workflows in a controlled trial before moving live donor data.
bestFor: Church charities needing to combine Gift Aid, GASDS and several donation channels
Treasurers reducing manual bank-transfer and spreadsheet claim administration
Churches able to test the live export, reconciliation and payment workflow before migration
strengths: Active UK supplier and current HMRC Charities Online listing
Multiple donation channels plus CSV import and cash workflow
Supplier documents both automated and hybrid claim routes
limitations: General charity product, not church-management, pastoral-care or safeguarding software
Full tier prices, card or payment fees, VAT and contract terms require a current written quote
No public product DPA, sub-processor list, hosting detail or full export specification found
Supplier claims about automation and data security should be tested against the church's own controls

procurementVerdict.problem: Joining online, bank-transfer, cash and contactless donations with a manageable UK Gift Aid process
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK charity giving platform that explicitly combines GASDS, bank-transfer and CSV workflows with Gift Aid claims
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Run the 14-day trial using a small non-sensitive sample, reconcile one representative donation of each intended type, inspect the HMRC claim output and obtain written payment, DPA, export, access-control and fee information before importing historical donor data
